title: Steve Papa – Entrepreneur's Perspective on Venture, Venture is Eating the Investment World 13 (Capital Allocators, EP.244)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Steve Papa has been part of reimagining the technology landscape for twenty years.
reader_summary.overview: Steve Papa has been part of reimagining the technology landscape for twenty years. He was the Founder and CEO of Endeca, an enterprise software company that Oracle acquired for $1.1 billion in 2011. After that, he invested in and became a founding Partner of six technology companies, including the lead investor in Toast.

key_points.text: Our conversation covers Steve's path into technology and entrepreneurship, the story of Endeca, and his subsequent venture investments.
Along the way, we touch on both lessons from his businesses and the intersection of those businesses with venture capital.
